name: capacityspot
description: CapacitySpot — Uganda's public CPD platform (CPD Rail)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server run db:setup
